# Folio

Local note indexing from the command line.

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.11

## Example

```bash
folio index ./notes
```

## Behavior

`folio index ./notes` reads the `./notes` directory and constructs a search index locally on your machine. All processing stays offline—Folio never uploads your notes to any remote server.

## Exit Status

- `0`: Local index built successfully.
- Non-zero: Indexing failed (for example, due to an unreadable path or runtime error).
outputs.with:
# Folio

Build a local search index from a directory of notes.

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.11

## Example

```bash
folio index ./notes
```

## Behavior

Running on Python 3.11, `folio index ./notes` reads `./notes` and builds an index locally on your machine. It never uploads notes to any remote service. The command exits with `0` when indexing succeeds and returns a non-zero status on failure.

## Exit Status

- `0`: Local index built successfully.
- Non-zero: Indexing failed.
